title: Opened Pea Pod
description: One newly authored static low-poly opened pea-pod appearance: a long tapered lower hollow valve with a flattened outer back, a second complete valve curled back along the long curved seam, a continuous seam rib and four separate full peas seated inside. Pale inner valve material is actual mesh surface, not a texture. Seven closed editable meshes and four opaque constant PBR materials. New whole geometry, not stretched prior castanet shells or extracted germinating-seed parts. Metres, Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred. Mature fruit appearance only, not animation, growth simulation, exact cultivar, food or cultivation guidance.
